about: Sites the as-data checker sees but does not count: a string literal that spells a content id but is not one. One entry per (file, literal) with a one-line reason; it covers every occurrence of that literal in that file. The checker lists these separately, and an entry whose site no longer exists is STALE and fails (tests/as-data-check.test.ts), so this list cannot rot.
